1→# ==========================================
     2→# FV-Julia Code Generator
     3→# FreeJulia → FV 2.0 코드 변환
     4→# ==========================================
     5→
     6→# ==========================================
     7→# 타입 매핑 정의
     8→# ==========================================
     9→
    10→record TypeMapping =
    11→  fj_type: String          # FreeJulia 타입
    12→  fv_type: String          # FV 2.0 타입
    13→  needs_import: Bool       # 임포트 필요 여부
    14→  conversion_func: String  # 변환 함수 (선택사항)
    15→
    16→# ==========================================
    17→# 기본 타입 매핑
    18→# ==========================================
    19→
    20→function get_type_mapping(fj_type: String): String =
    21→  match fj_type {
    22→    "Int" -> "i32",
    23→    "Float" -> "f64",
    24→    "String" -> "String",
    25→    "Bool" -> "bool",
    26→    "Void" -> "void",
    27→    _ -> (
    28→      # Array 타입 처리
    29→      if fj_type.contains("Array[") then
    30→        let elem_type = extract_array_element_type(fj_type)
    31→        let mapped_elem = get_type_mapping(elem_type)
    32→        "Array(" + mapped_elem + ")"
    33→      else if fj_type.contains("Dictionary[") then
    34→        # Dictionary[K, V] → Map(K, V)
    35→        "Map(String, String)"
    36→      else if fj_type.contains("Function[") then
    37→        # Function → 함수 포인터
    38→        "fn(String) String"
    39→      else
    40→        # 기본값: 타입명 그대로
    41→        fj_type
    42→      end
    43→    )
    44→  }
    45→
    46→# ==========================================
    47→# Array 타입 추출
    48→# ==========================================
    49→
    50→function extract_array_element_type(array_type: String): String =
    51→  # "Array[Int]" → "Int"
    52→  if array_type.contains("Array[") then
    53→    let start = 6  # "Array[".length()
    54→    let end = array_type.length() - 1
    55→    array_type.substring(start, end)
    56→  else
    57→    "Unknown"
    58→  end
    59→
    60→# ==========================================
    61→# 함수 정의 변환
    62→# ==========================================
    63→
    64→record FunctionDef =
    65→  name: String
    66→  params: Array[String]           # param_name: type 형식
    67→  return_type: String
    68→  body: String
    69→
    70→function convert_function_def(fj_func: FunctionDef): String =
    71→  # FreeJulia:  function add(a: Int, b: Int): Int = a + b
    72→  # FV 2.0:     func add(a i32, b i32) i32 { return a + b }
    73→
    74→  let fv_code = "func " + fj_func.name + "("
    75→  
    76→  # 파라미터 변환
    77→  let param_parts = Array[String]()
    78→  for param in fj_func.params do
    79→    # "a: Int" → "a i32"
    80→    let parts = param.split(":")
    81→    if parts.length() == 2 then
    82→      let param_name = parts[0].trim()
    83→      let param_type = parts[1].trim()
    84→      let fv_type = get_type_mapping(param_type)
    85→      param_parts.push(param_name + " " + fv_type)
    86→    end
    87→  end
    88→  
    89→  fv_code = fv_code + join_array(param_parts, ", ") + ") "
    90→  
    91→  # 반환 타입
    92→  let fv_return_type = get_type_mapping(fj_func.return_type)
    93→  fv_code = fv_code + fv_return_type + " {\n"
    94→  
    95→  # 함수 본문
    96→  fv_code = fv_code + "  return " + fj_func.body + "\n"
    97→  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
    98→  
    99→  fv_code
   100→
   101→# ==========================================
   102→# 배열 조인 (헬퍼)
   103→# ==========================================
   104→
   105→function join_array(arr: Array[String], separator: String): String =
   106→  let result = ""
   107→  for i in 0:arr.length() do
   108→    if i > 0 then
   109→      result = result + separator
   110→    end
   111→    result = result + arr[i]
   112→  end
   113→  result
   114→
   115→# ==========================================
   116→# 제어 흐름 변환
   117→# ==========================================
   118→
   119→function convert_if_statement(condition: String, then_body: String, else_body: String): String =
   120→  # if condition then body1 else body2 end
   121→  # →
   122→  # if (condition) { body1 } else { body2 }
   123→
   124→  let fv_code = "if (" + condition + ") {\n"
   125→  fv_code = fv_code + "  " + then_body + "\n"
   126→  
   127→  if else_body.length() > 0 then
   128→    fv_code = fv_code + "} else {\n"
   129→    fv_code = fv_code + "  " + else_body + "\n"
   130→  end
   131→  
   132→  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
   133→  fv_code
   134→
   135→function convert_for_loop(var_name: String, start: String, end: String, body: String): String =
   136→  # for i in start:end do body end
   137→  # →
   138→  # for (i32 i = start; i < end; i++) { body }
   139→
   140→  let fv_code = "for (i32 " + var_name + " = " + start + "; "
   141→  fv_code = fv_code + var_name + " < " + end + "; "
   142→  fv_code = fv_code + var_name + "++) {\n"
   143→  fv_code = fv_code + "  " + body + "\n"
   144→  fv_code = fv_code + "}"
   145→  
   146→  fv_code
   147→
   148→# ==========================================
   149→# 표현식 변환
   150→# ==========================================
   151→
   152→function convert_arithmetic_expr(op: String, left: String, right: String): String =
   153→  # a + b → a + b (그대로)
   154→  "(" + left + " " + op + " " + right + ")"
   155→
   156→function convert_function_call(func_name: String, args: Array[String]): String =
   157→  # func(a, b) → func(a, b) (그대로)
   158→  func_name + "(" + join_array(args, ", ") + ")"
   159→
   160→function convert_array_access(array_name: String, index: String): String =
   161→  # arr[0] → arr[0] (그대로)
   162→  array_name + "[" + index + "]"
   163→
   164→# ==========================================
   165→# 메인 Code Generator
   166→# ==========================================
   167→
   168→record CodeGenerator =
   169→  output: String
   170→  indent_level: Int
   171→
   172→function new_code_generator(): CodeGenerator =
   173→  CodeGenerator {
   174→    output: "",
   175→    indent_level: 0
   176→  }
   177→
   178→function emit_code(gen: CodeGenerator, code: String): CodeGenerator =
   179→  let new_gen = CodeGenerator {
   180→    output: gen.output + code,
   181→    indent_level: gen.indent_level
   182→  }
   183→  new_gen
   184→
   185→function get_indent(gen: CodeGenerator): String =
   186→  let indent = ""
   187→  for i in 0:gen.indent_level do
   188→    indent = indent + "  "
   189→  end
   190→  indent
   191→
   192→# ==========================================
   193→# 테스트 헬퍼
   194→# ==========================================
   195→
   196→function test_type_mapping(): Bool =
   197→  let int_type = get_type_mapping("Int")
   198→  let array_type = get_type_mapping("Array[Int]")
   199→  let dict_type = get_type_mapping("Dictionary[String, Int]")
   200→  
   201→  int_type == "i32" && 
   202→  array_type == "Array(i32)" && 
   203→  dict_type == "Map(String, String)"
   204→
   205→function test_function_conversion(): Bool =
   206→  let func = FunctionDef {
   207→    name: "add",
   208→    params: ["a: Int", "b: Int"],
   209→    return_type: "Int",
   210→    body: "a + b"
   211→  }
   212→  
   213→  let result = convert_function_def(func)
   214→  result.contains("func add(a i32, b i32) i32")
   215→
   216→function test_if_conversion(): Bool =
   217→  let result = convert_if_statement("x > 0", "y = 1", "y = 0")
   218→  result.contains("if (x > 0)") && result.contains("} else {")
   219→
   220→function test_for_conversion(): Bool =
   221→  let result = convert_for_loop("i", "0", "10", "sum = sum + i")
   222→  result.contains("for (i32 i = 0; i < 10; i++)")
   223→
   224→# ==========================================
   225→# 실행
   226→# ==========================================
   227→
   228→function main(): Unit =
   229→  let tests = [
   230→    ("test_type_mapping", test_type_mapping()),
   231→    ("test_function_conversion", test_function_conversion()),
   232→    ("test_if_conversion", test_if_conversion()),
   233→    ("test_for_conversion", test_for_conversion())
   234→  ]
   235→  
   236→  let passed = 0
   237→  let failed = 0
   238→  
   239→  for (name, result) in tests do
   240→    if result then
   241→      println("[✓] " + name)
   242→      passed = passed + 1
   243→    else
   244→      println("[✗] " + name)
   245→      failed = failed + 1
   246→    end
   247→  end
   248→  
   249→  println("\n=========================================")
   250→  println("Phase 1: Code Generator Validation")
   251→  println("Passed: " + passed.to_string())
   252→  println("Failed: " + failed.to_string())
   253→  println("=========================================")
   254→
